## The problem

What you were trying to do, and where the current instructions fell short.

## The run that showed it

The invocation, the mode, and what the lead or a worker did. A change request without a real run behind it is hard to judge.

## Proposed change

The smallest change to the instructions that would have helped. Say which file it belongs in.

## What it must not weaken

Any limit in the safety model this change touches.
